title: How many LLM-labelled rows does a decision encoder need, and how wrong can the labels be?
abstract: arXiv:2611.16498v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A decision encoder such as Laya reads a question with named options (for example, which department should handle a ticket) and a text, and picks an option. It reads both in one forward pass and returns a probability for every option, without writing any text. We ask how many LLM-written training rows such an encoder needs and how wrong those labels may be. We ran 19 fine-tunes of Laya (ModernBERT-large) on nested subsets of a 2,818-row pool and scored them on 1,065 held-out items from the same generator, so every test item is in-distribution and no out-of-family test was run. Accuracy rises from 69.4% before fine-tuning to 74.3% with 5% of the rows, 84.8% with 50% and 86.9% with all rows. The curve flattens, and a saturating fit with bootstrap intervals cannot pin down its plateau. Seed spread at 20% of the rows (s.d. 1.6 points) exceeds some of the steps between sizes. translated_title: 决策编码器需要多少条 LLM 标注的数据行？这些标签可以错到什么程度？
translated_abstract: 诸如 Laya 之类的决策编码器会读取一个带有命名选项的问题（例如，哪个部门应该处理某个工单）和一段文本，并从中选择一个选项。它在一次前向传播中同时读取两者，并为每个选项返回一个概率，而不生成任何文本。我们探究这样一个编码器需要多少条由 LLM 撰写的训练数据行，以及这些标签可能错到什么程度。我们在一个包含 2,818 行数据的池的嵌套子集上对 Laya（ModernBERT-large）进行了 19 次微调，并在来自同一生成器的 1,065 个保留测试项上进行评分，因此每个测试项都在分布之内，且没有进行分布外测试。准确率从微调前的 69.4% 提升至使用 5% 数据行时的 74.3%、使用 50% 数据行时的 84.8%，以及使用全部数据行时的 86.9%。曲线趋于平缓，而带有自助法置信区间的饱和拟合也无法确定其平台期。在 20% 数据行时的随机种子差异（标准差 1.6 个百分点）超过了某些数据规模之间的提升幅度。给予小规模子集与全量数据池相同数量的更新步数可获得 1.9 个百分点的收益。
tldr: 决策编码器 Laya 仅用少量 LLM 标注数据即可显著提升准确率（5% 数据从 69.4% 升至 74.3%），但收益随数据量增加而趋于饱和，且随机种子差异和标签噪声对结果的影响不可忽视。
en_tdlr: A decision encoder like Laya achieves substantial accuracy gains from small amounts of LLM-labelled data (69.4% to 74.3% with just 5% of rows), but returns diminish as data scales, with seed variance and label noise significantly affecting the results.
